```{=html}
<script>
// Sticky day selector: keep it under the site navbar and highlight the day in view
(function () {
  var nav = document.querySelector(".tl-nav");
  if (!nav) return;
  var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll(".tl-nav-day"));
  var days = links.map(function (a) { return document.getElementById(a.dataset.day); });
  var root = document.documentElement;

  function layout() {
    var header = document.getElementById("quarto-header");
    var top = header ? header.getBoundingClientRect().bottom : 0;
    root.style.setProperty("--tl-top", Math.max(top, 0) + "px");
    root.style.setProperty("--tl-nav-h", nav.offsetHeight + "px");
  }

  function update() {
    var line = nav.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 24;
    var current = 0;
    days.forEach(function (day, i) {
      if (day && day.getBoundingClientRect().top <= line) current = i;
    });
    // At the very bottom of the page the last day is always the active one
    if (window.innerHeight + window.scrollY >= document.documentElement.scrollHeight - 2) current = days.length - 1;
    links.forEach(function (a, i) {
      var on = i === current;
      if (on && a.getAttribute("aria-current") !== "true") {
        // scroll the selector itself on narrow screens, without moving the page
        var box = a.parentNode;
        box.scrollTo({ left: a.offsetLeft - (box.clientWidth - a.offsetWidth) / 2, behavior: "smooth" });
      }
      if (on) a.setAttribute("aria-current", "true"); else a.removeAttribute("aria-current");
    });
  }

  var ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener("scroll", function () {
    if (ticking) return;
    ticking = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { update(); ticking = false; });
  }, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () { layout(); update(); });
  window.addEventListener("load", function () { layout(); update(); });
  layout();
  update();
})();
</script>
```
